summary.one_liner: A curated link list of Site Reliability Engineering and production engineering resources, covering articles, books, talks, blogs, newsletters, meetups and tools.
summary.what_it_does: This is an "awesome" list, so it contains no code, only links with short descriptions. It is organized into sections such as Culture, Education, Books, Hiring, Reliability, Monitoring & Observability & Alerting, On-Call, Post-Mortem, Capacity Planning, Service Level Agreement, Performance, and Programming. A second group covers Misc Articles, Real-time Messaging (Slack channels), Blogs, Newsletters, Conferences & Meetups, Twitter accounts, SRE Tools, and Podcasts. Most entries are individual articles or talks from companies such as Google, Netflix, Twitter, Uber, and others, plus several CRE life lessons posts. The README states that contributions are welcome and points to contribution guidelines.
use_cases: Finding SRE reading material on incident response and postmortems
Learning how to define SLIs, SLOs and error budgets
Locating books on site reliability and monitoring
Following SRE blogs, newsletters and podcasts
Preparing for SRE hiring or career moves
notable: Very broad coverage, with sections on culture, on-call, postmortems, SLOs, and chaos engineering
Includes a long list of incident management guides, such as Atlassian and PagerDuty handbooks
Groups links into blogs, newsletters, podcasts, and Slack communities for ongoing follow-up
Links to a separate awesome list of SRE tools
caveats: Links are only descriptions; the list does not review or rate the linked resources
Some entries are marked retired, such as On Call Nightmares podcast, and some links may be out of date
